notes: Build time is wall-clock on the recording machine; counts and file:line values are stable for this demo.
The stamp digest is derived from source file sizes and mtimes, so it differs on a fresh checkout even though the graph content is identical.
The demo is synthetic and shipped with the repository; no user project is represented.
limitations: Native .wxml projects only; Taro, uni-app and kbone compiled output are not analysed.
Only .js sources are parsed; .ts files are not analysed.
WXSS and styling are out of scope: the graph has no stylesheet edges.
Cloud-function bodies are not parsed; only wx.cloud.callFunction call sites are recorded.
WXML expressions yield data paths, not evaluated values; ternaries and method calls are not computed.
No watch mode or incremental reindex: re-run wxgraph build after edits.
